programs.name: Artifact Lab
programs.focus: Nwagu Aneke and other African knowledge artifacts as source-critical research objects.

programs.name: PAGC / Formalization Lab
programs.focus: Competing structural models derived from Nwagu Aneke, including base-modifier, syllabary grid, codebook, reader-mark, and visual algebra models.

programs.name: OGI / Governance Measurement Lab
programs.focus: Community-led digital governance metrics and Oroma evidence extraction.

programs.name: Research Spine / Evidence Infrastructure Lab
programs.focus: A lab-wide source/event -> fact -> claim -> evidence gate -> output pipeline.

programs.name: African NLP + Low-Resource AI Lab
programs.focus: Igbo corpora, tokenization, diacritics, transcription, and benchmarks.

programs.name: Visual Atlas / Interface Lab
programs.focus: Dashboards, atlases, Obsidian canvases, and public-facing research maps.

programs.name: Ethics + Sovereignty Lab
programs.focus: CARE/FAIR, consent, community authority, rights review, and responsible release.

programs.name: Publication + Translation Lab
programs.focus: Papers, negative results, datasets, standards, policy briefs, teaching modules, and exhibitions.

top_research_branches.claim: The source artifact can be reconstructed as a CV syllabary grid plus a separate logograph inventory.
The f/v row should be tested as a dialect-specific phonological collapse or orthographic economy.
216 may be useful as a designed normalization, but not as a source-observed fact.
E6 claims are blocked until an independently justified 27-element object exists.
Biological analogies may inspire design language but are not evidence for PAGC.
Product events can become OGI facts through the Research Spine.
The lab can generalize source/event -> fact -> claim -> gate -> output across programs.
top_research_branches.evidence: This lab OS build; corpus and claim-gate artifacts.

top_research_branches.claim: A standards path exists only after character inventory, names, glyph variants, usage examples, and rights/community review.
top_research_branches.evidence: Unicode L2/23-203 external lead; source dossier gap analysis.
